preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.themeHint: Dark is easier on the eyes at the gym.
preferences.unitHint: How weights are shown and typed. They are kept in kilograms, so nothing is converted.
preferences.unitBusy: Finish the workout in progress first: its weights are typed in the current unit.
preferences.restHint: When an exercise of the plan sets no rest of its own.
preferences.countdownHint: Seconds to get ready before a timed set's stopwatch starts.
preferences.stepHint: How much − and + move the weight in workout mode.
preferences.soundHint: Beeps at the end of a rest, in the countdown before a timed set and when a hold ends.
preferences.vibrationHint: At the same moments, on phones that can vibrate (not iPhones).
preferences.rpeHint: A target effort from 1 to 10 beside the reps, in the plan editor.
